vulnerability: Employees may interact with deceptive email or sign-in pages
existing_controls: Email filtering, multifactor authentication, and quarterly awareness training

vulnerability: Endpoints may execute malicious files before detection or isolation
existing_controls: Endpoint detection and response, application patching, and restricted local administrator rights

vulnerability: Sensitive records may be exposed through compromised credentials or application weaknesses
existing_controls: Database encryption, security logging, least-privilege roles, and vulnerability scanning

vulnerability: Incorrect AWS storage or network settings could expose portal resources
existing_controls: Infrastructure templates, peer review, cloud configuration alerts, and quarterly access review

vulnerability: Dependence on one processor limits immediate transaction-processing alternatives
existing_controls: Service-level agreement, vendor monitoring, incident contacts, and manual continuity procedures

vulnerability: Weak or stolen credentials could be used to access privileged services
existing_controls: Multifactor authentication, conditional access, sign-in monitoring, and account lockout

vulnerability: Portable devices may be lost or stolen outside bank facilities
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption, automatic screen lock, mobile device management, and remote wipe

vulnerability: Backup jobs or restore procedures may fail without timely detection
existing_controls: Daily backup monitoring, isolated copies, retention controls, and semiannual restore tests

vulnerability: Public portal capacity could be overwhelmed by high-volume malicious traffic
existing_controls: Cloud traffic filtering, rate limiting, monitoring alerts, and provider escalation procedures

vulnerability: Accumulated access rights may exceed current job responsibilities
existing_controls: Manager approvals, role-based access groups, and annual access certification
